presets.description: Uses all 35 cases and repeated trials for directive evaluation.

presets.label: Production — 5 iterations
presets.description: Preserves all 35 cases and Production trial counts, with at most five iterations. Fewer proposals reduce opportunities for improvement.

presets.label: Test
presets.description: Checks execution with 23 cases, one trial per case, and at most two iterations. Scores remain exploratory; directive improvement requires a full evaluation.
